Name: item count over uint16 max
Reason: item count 65536 > 65535 (PROTOCOL.md §5.2/§8); the [Q] suffix expands to 65536 items

Name: negative bin dimension
Reason: bin dimension Length < 0 must be rejected on encode (§5.2/§8)

Name: zero item dimension
Reason: item dimension Width = 0 must be rejected on encode; dimensions must be >= 1 (§5.2/§8)

Name: negative item length
Reason: item dimension Length < 0 must be rejected on encode (§5.2/§8)

Name: negative item coordinate
Reason: item coordinate X < 0 must be rejected on encode (§5.2/§8)

Name: item dimension above max
Reason: item dimension Length = 65536 exceeds the max value 65535; must be rejected on encode (§5.1/§8)

Name: item coordinate above max
Reason: item coordinate X = 65536 exceeds the max value 65535; must be rejected on encode (§5.1/§8)
